body.x: News Dog Ventures will showcase News Dog, a media content search engine, at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri).

News Dog Ventures is a company that provides various types of media services based on big data technology. It is concentrating on News Dog, a search engine specialized in media contents. 'News Dog' is a fake news tracking system that combines the expertise of a professional journalist with high technology.

It implements the fake news tracking system by finding the contact points of the expertise of the media and the algorithmic technology, and implements the service to prevent the suspected information that is considered to be fake news in advance. In addition, it boasts high accuracy due to 'development of Korean natural language processing technology' based on user's online language.

In addition to fake news tracking, the News Dog search engine is building a comprehensive content platform with a variety of features. The function is as follows. △ Content export △ Public relations / marketing performance measurement △ Real time financial disclosure △ Improved accessibility of high quality contents

'News Dog Ventures', which researches and develops News Dog, is funded by Ministry of SMEs and Startups and various organizations, and is receiving great interest in domestic VCs, universities and research institutes.

An official from News Dog Ventures said, "We plan to update and add new content every year, which will broaden our business." "We plan to participate in CES and Edison Awards in order to expand overseas market share."

On the other hand, Daejeon Center for Creative Economy and Innovation is carrying out educational programs on the fostering of venture enterprises in Daejeon that are small but strong. They are helping companies with various activities such as Dream Venture Star (DVS), economic cooperation industry development project, technology innovation type enterprise support project (open voucher) and actively making efforts to support CES 2019 participation. The following companies are participating in CES 2019 with support from the Daejeon Center for Creative Economy and Innovation. ▲ News Dog Ventures ▲ Classum ▲ Fairip. These companies will also participate in 'MIK Night' organized by AVING news on the 3rd day of the exhibition.
